lines.en: label nodokaspecial20:
scene stillcalm1
: You...want to know about the tendrils of the sky?
lines.zh: : 您……想了解天空的触须？

lines.en: : I’d like to know anything and everything. {i}Knowing{/i} is kind of what I do.
lines.zh: : 我想知道任何事、一切事。「{i}知道{/i}」本来就是我的本行。

lines.en: : What a surprise. Knowing is what Yasu does as well. Maybe you’d like to lend her your arm so she can get off of mine?
lines.zh: : 真巧。「知道」也是 Yasu 的本行。也许你愿意把你的胳膊借给她，好让她从我的胳膊上下来？

lines.en: : I’m happy to lend my arm to just about anybody.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意把胳膊借给几乎任何人。

lines.en: : Could’ve fooled me.
lines.zh: : 我可没看出来。

lines.en: : Ha. Funny.
lines.zh: : 哈。真幽默。

lines.en: : The tightness in my chest tells me that I should not switch arms...and that any arm apart from this one has the potential to infect me with feelings I do not deserve to feel.
lines.zh: : 我胸口的紧绷告诉我，我不该换胳膊……而且除了这条胳膊以外的任何胳膊，都有可能传染给我一些我不配拥有的感情。

lines.en: : Are you certain that’s what the {i}tightness{/i} is telling you? Because, based on my experience-
lines.zh: : 您确定那股{i}紧绷{/i}是这么告诉您的吗？因为根据我的经验——

lines.en: : So anyway, tendrils.
lines.zh: : 总之，触须。

lines.en: scene stillcalm2
: Right! It is my duty to be the font of information undocumented, so I will tell you all about the opening of the sky and the tendrils that extend beyond man’s wildest imagination.
lines.zh: : 对！作为未被记载之知识的泉源是我的职责，那么就由我来告诉您，天空的裂口，以及那些伸展开来、超越人类最狂野想象的触须。

lines.en: : There is only one god. A god of infinite eyes. But there are forces in this world that would have people believe otherwise.
lines.zh: : 神只有一位。一位拥有无限之眼的神。但这世上有一些力量，想要让人相信并非如此。

lines.en: : Forces of great power, but poor intent. And often times, these powers are used to both intimidate and scare those who walk His holy grounds.
lines.zh: : 力量极大，却用心不良。而这些力量常常被用来恐吓那些行走在祂圣地之上的人。

lines.en: : The tendrils of the sky are one of many examples of this. And while their tangibility is not the same as if you were to reach out and touch me, the impact they would have on you would be much greater.
lines.zh: : 天空的触须就是其中一例。虽然它们的实体感并不像您伸手触碰我那样，但它们对您产生的影响要大得多。

lines.en: : Your mind would turn to dust. Your organs to ash. And all of your thoughts congealed into a twisting mass of ivy that feeds into the dirt and goes on to stretch from building to building.
lines.zh: : 您的心智会化为尘埃。您的脏器化为灰烬。而您所有的思绪会凝结成一团缠绕的常春藤，扎进泥土，从一栋建筑蔓延到另一栋建筑。

lines.en: : So...the sky would have us returned to the ground?
lines.zh: : 所以……天空是要让我们回到地面？

lines.en: scene stillcalm3
: You hear my words, but misjudge their meaning. This world is not as simple as one above and one below.
lines.zh: : 您听见了我的话，却误解了其中的含义。这个世界并不像一上一下那么简单。

lines.en: : It is an endless labyrinth of layers invisible to the naked eye...each with its own steady stream of waste.
lines.zh: : 它是一座由肉眼看不见的层层结构组成的无尽迷宫……每一层都有自己的、源源不断的废物流。

lines.en: : They all flow into one pool that we are forced to bathe in.
lines.zh: : 它们全都流进同一个池子，而我们被迫在其中沐浴。

lines.en: : The dirty runoff is collected and returned to the sky.
lines.zh: : 那些污浊的径流被收集起来，送回天空。

lines.en: : And so the ground mixes with the air...and rains down upon the ivy, cannibalizing itself as it recycles energy and becomes stronger in a way much more difficult than simply asking Him for power.
lines.zh: : 于是大地与空气交融……化作雨落在常春藤上，在循环能量的过程中自我吞噬，以一种远比单纯向祂祈求力量更艰难的方式变得更强。

lines.en: : We all become water. We all become dirt. It is the cycle of everything that is and everything that wants to be. And only He can pull us from the vines and save us from this never ending circling of the drain.
lines.zh: : 我们都会变成水。我们都会变成土。这是一切存在之物、一切想要存在之物的循环。而只有祂能把我们从藤蔓中拉出来，从这场无休止的下水道打转中拯救我们。

lines.en: : I couldn’t have said it better myself.
lines.zh: : 我自己都未必能说得更好。

lines.en: : Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : Why haven’t I heard of this...fascinating religion before?
lines.zh: : 为什么我之前从来没听说过这个……迷人的宗教？

lines.en: scene stillcalm4
: Because I am the only one who speaks of it! Are you interested? Do you seek salvation? For if you do, I can show you the light.
lines.zh: : 因为只有我一个人在讲它！您感兴趣吗？您寻求救赎吗？如果是的话，我可以让您看见光。

lines.en: : And before you know it, you will be bathing in its warmth rather than a puddle of human excrement.
lines.zh: : 不知不觉间，您就会沐浴在它的温暖里，而不是泡在一滩人类的排泄物里。

lines.en: : I think I’ll stick to bathhouses and showers. But I thank you for taking the time to explain a bit about your religion to me. I won’t lie in saying I’ve been very curious since the moment you walked in.
lines.zh: : 我想我还是继续用澡堂和淋浴吧。不过谢谢您花时间给我讲了讲您的宗教。说实话，从您走进来的那一刻起，我就非常好奇了。

lines.en: : I...was worried you were going to say something mean to her.
lines.zh: : 我……还担心你会对她说什么刻薄的话。

lines.en: scene stillcalm5
: You were? Why?
lines.zh: : 你担心了？为什么？

lines.en: : Well...you’ve always been very quick to debate people when it comes to religion.
lines.zh: : 嗯……一谈到宗教，你总是很快就跟人辩论起来。

lines.en: : Futaba, as an atheist, I am obligated to do just that. But there is a certain fundamental basis to what Yasu preaches that I see no reason to speak out against.
lines.zh: : Futaba，作为一个无神论者，我有义务这么做。但 Yasu 宣讲的东西里有一种根本性的基础，我看不出有什么理由要反对。

lines.en: : She speaks of a cycle. And while it is essentially just a rehashed and painted version of the {i}water{/i} cycle, it’s not as if she’s telling us about stone tablets that dictate the way we live our lives...
lines.zh: : 她讲的是循环。虽然那本质上只是{i}水{/i}循环的翻新版、涂了一层色，可她又不是在跟我们讲什么规定我们该怎么活的石碑……

lines.en: : She did talk about giant invisible sky tentacles, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她确实讲了巨大的、隐形的天空触手。

lines.en: scene stillcalm6
: And I hope she is right about them for that is the single most enticing thing I have ever heard about any religion.
lines.zh: : 而我希望她是对的，因为那是我听过的所有宗教里最诱人的一件事。

lines.en: : Just wait until you learn what my supposed duty would be if I were a devout follower.
lines.zh: : 等你听说我要是个虔诚的信徒，我的「职责」会是什么，你就知道了。

lines.en: : Oh? Would you care to educate me?
lines.zh: : 哦？您愿意指点一下吗？

lines.en: : I don’t want to say it in front of Futaba. She’s still too pure.
lines.zh: : 我不想当着 Futaba 的面说。她还是太纯洁了。

lines.en: scene stillcalm7
: I...I am?!
lines.zh: : 我……我是吗？！

lines.en: : Still?
lines.zh: : 还是？

lines.en: : I would have figured that...you know...
lines.zh: : 我还以为……你知道的……

lines.en: : Yes, Futaba...share the juicy details of what whisked away your purity out loud. Loud enough for the whole class to hear.
lines.zh: : 来吧，Futaba……大声说出夺走你纯洁的那些劲爆细节。要大到全班都听得见。

lines.en: : Or don’t.
lines.zh: : 或者别说。

lines.en: : In fact, definitely don’t. It’s been over five minutes and I have officially overstayed my welcome.
lines.zh: : 事实上，绝对别说。已经过了五分钟了，我正式赖太久了。

lines.en: scene black
: What welcome? You know you’re welcome here any time, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 什么赖太久？您知道的，随时都欢迎您来，老师。

lines.en: : I am honoring Yasu’s premonition and only sticking around for a little while today. After that, you’re all on your own. Or...at least under Imani’s supervision.
lines.zh: : 我是在尊重 Yasu 的预感，今天只待一小会儿。之后你们就自求多福吧。或者说……至少有 Imani 看着。

lines.en: : That said, Yasu- back to your seat.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，Yasu——回你的座位去。

lines.en: : Okay. Thank you for being with me, Sensei. I was entirely unworthy of your protection, yet received it anyway.
lines.zh: : 好的。谢谢您陪着我，老师。我根本不配得到您的保护，却还是得到了。

lines.en: : I can hardly even hear any whispers about the bad thing anymore.
lines.zh: : 我甚至几乎听不见任何关于那件坏事的低语了。

lines.en: : That’s great news. Anyway, goodbye everyone. It’s been-
lines.zh: : 这真是好消息。总之，大家再见。这段时间——

lines.en: : Wait one second, Sensei. Don’t you think {i}I{/i} need a little protection too? It’s not fair if only Yasu gets some, is it?
lines.zh: : 等一下，老师。您不觉得{i}我{/i}也需要一点保护吗？只有 Yasu 有，这可不公平吧？

lines.en: : What would you need protection for?
lines.zh: : 你需要什么保护？

lines.en: : You haven't been groping Makoto again, have you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会又去摸 Makoto 了吧？

lines.en: : Okay, I’m suddenly interested in staying.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我突然有兴趣留下了。

lines.en: I follow Nodoka and Futaba over to their seats on the side of the room, both surprised and {i}un{/i}surprised to hear about Nodoka’s {i}second{/i} sexual violation over the last 24 hours.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Nodoka 和 Futaba 走到教室边上她们的座位，听到 Nodoka 在过去二十四小时里的{i}第二{/i}起性骚扰，我既意外又{i}不{/i}意外。

lines.en: The two of them pick up exactly where they left off before I wandered into class late and proceed with the conversation as if I’m not extremely turned on by the thought of it.
lines.zh: 她们两个从我迟到溜进教室之前的那个地方接上话头，继续聊了下去，仿佛我并没有因为这个念头而极度兴奋似的。

lines.en: scene stillcalm8
: I’ll try to keep this short seeing as Sensei is likely extremely turned on by the thought of it-
lines.zh: : 我尽量长话短说，毕竟老师很可能光是想想就兴奋得不行——

lines.en: Yeah, I should have seen that coming.
lines.zh: 是啊，我早该料到的。

lines.en: : But yes. I {i}have{/i} been groping Makoto again and it has been very fun for both of us.
lines.zh: : 不过没错。我{i}又{/i}去摸 Makoto 了，而且我们两个都玩得很开心。

lines.en: : It has?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : I...don’t think it has. I’m pretty sure Makoto isn’t bisexual.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得不是。我敢肯定 Makoto 不是双性恋。

lines.en: : You don’t need to be bisexual in order to enjoy the sensation of the sex you’re not interested in exploring your body.
lines.zh: : 你不需要是双性恋，才能享受一个你没兴趣的人摸索你身体的感觉。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure...that’s exactly what you need to be bisexual for.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定……那恰恰就是双性恋的定义。

lines.en: : Well, either way, Makoto isn’t the type to put a hit out on me over something as trivial as a little bit of dubiously consensual rubbing.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管怎样，Makoto 不是那种会为了一点半推半就的抚摸就找人报复我的类型。

lines.en: scene stillcalm9
: It wasn’t {i}dubious!{/i} I told you to stop repeatedly!
lines.zh: : 那才不是{i}半推半就{/i}！我说了很多次让你停手！

lines.en: : Ignore her. She doesn’t know what she’s talking about.
lines.zh: : 别理她。她不知道自己在说什么。

lines.en: scene stillcalm10
: The fact of the matter is, I have no idea who would have something against me. I just couldn’t handle the idea of being apart from Sensei for an entire day.
lines.zh: : 事实是，我根本不知道谁会对我有意见。我只是受不了要和老师分开一整天。

lines.en: : And seeing as you always have a much better time when he’s around as well, I figured I’d try keeping him here for as long as he’s able to stay interested.
lines.zh: : 而且既然他在的时候你也会开心得多，我就想，不如尽量把他留在这儿，留到他还能保持兴趣为止。

lines.en: scene stillcalm11
: Quick, Futaba. Remove your blouse. That will keep him grounded.
lines.zh: : 快，Futaba。把衬衫脱了。那样能让他留在这儿。

lines.en: : I am not removing anything, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不会脱，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Not even for me?
lines.zh: : 连为了我都不脱？

lines.en: : {i}Especially{/i} not for you. Stop assuming everyone is bi.
lines.zh: : {i}尤其{/i}不会为了你。别再觉得所有人都是双性恋了。

lines.en: : I bet {i}Rin{/i} would take off her blouse for me.
lines.zh: : 我敢打赌 {i}Rin{/i} 会为了我脱掉衬衫。

lines.en: : She has. You have literally worn her clothes.
lines.zh: : 她脱过。你可是真的穿过她的衣服。

lines.en: scene stillcalm12
: Oh, you’re right.
lines.zh: : 哦，你说得对。

lines.en: : I should probably return her underwear.
lines.zh: : 我大概该把她的内衣还回去了。

lines.en: scene black
scene stillcalm13
: ...and that’s exactly why I think you guys should have matching outfits!
lines.zh: : ……所以这就是为什么我觉得你们应该穿配套的演出服！

lines.en: : They obviously don’t need to be, like...{i}identical{/i} or anything. But tons of girl-bands do it and it’s a great way to rope in fans.
lines.zh: : 当然不必……{i}一模一样{/i}什么的。可好多女子乐队都这么做，这是吸引粉丝的好办法。

lines.en: : Yeah, but like...
lines.zh: : 嗯，可是……

lines.en: : We haven’t even written a song yet.
lines.zh: : 我们连一首歌都还没写出来呢。

lines.en: : So what? It doesn’t need to be {i}now.{/i} I just mean eventually.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？又不是{i}现在{/i}就要。我只是说早晚的事。

lines.en: : Yeah, but like...
lines.zh: : 嗯，可是……

lines.en: : Sana can’t even reach the bass pedal yet.
lines.zh: : Sana 连贝斯踏板都踩不到呢。

lines.en: scene stillcalm14
: I guess my first course of action should be finding a shorter stool then.
lines.zh: : 那我第一步大概该去找个矮一点的凳子。

lines.en: scene stillcalm15
: Oh, Yumi! You’re here earlier than normal today. How was spending the night with Chinami?
lines.zh: : 哦，Yumi！你今天来得比平时早。在 Chinami 家过夜怎么样？

lines.en: : She texted me saying you were acting a little weird and-
lines.zh: : 她发短信跟我说你有点怪怪的，然后——

lines.en: : It was great.
lines.zh: : 挺好的。

lines.en: : I had a good time.
lines.zh: : 我玩得很开心。

lines.en: scene stillcalm16
: Uhh...did you? Because you seem a little out of it.
lines.zh: : 呃……是吗？因为你看起来有点魂不守舍。

lines.en: : If you didn’t sleep well, maybe you should head back home and get some rest. It’s not like Sensei is going to mark you absent or anything.
lines.zh: : 要是你没睡好，也许该回家休息一下。反正老师又不会给你记缺勤什么的。

lines.en: scene stillcalm17
: Besides, Imani has been fending off Kirin all day, so she probably won’t even notice you’re-
lines.zh: : 再说，Imani 一整天都在应付 Kirin，她大概根本不会注意到你——

lines.en: : Sorry. Hold that thought.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。先等一下。

lines.en: scene stillcalm18
: Umm...Yumi?
lines.zh: : 嗯……Yumi？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Chika?...
lines.zh: : Chika？……

lines.en: : I’ve got a really bad feeling about this.
lines.zh: : 我有种非常不好的预感。

lines.en: scene stillcalm19
: And...what about for this one? Is it the same thing?
lines.zh: : 那……这道题呢？也是一样的吗？

lines.en: : Correct. You have to figure out the values to make the denominator equal to zero. After that, it’s just rewriting the fraction and canceling out any like factors.
lines.zh: : 对。你得求出让分母为零的值。之后就只是把分式改写一下、约掉相同的因式。

lines.en: : Did Sensei really never teach you this? What has he been doing the whole year?
lines.zh: : 老师真的从来没教过你这个？他一整年都在干什么？

lines.en: : Sleeping...
lines.zh: : 睡觉……

lines.en: : And flirting...
lines.zh: : 还有调情……

lines.en: : And sleeping...
lines.zh: : 还有睡觉……

lines.en: : Wow. What a life.
lines.zh: : 哇。这日子过的。

lines.en: : Good morning, Einstein.
lines.zh: : 早上好啊，爱因斯坦。

lines.en: scene stillcalm20
: Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哎呀糟糕。

lines.en: : Oh. Good morning, Yumi. Do you need any help with the math homework that-
lines.zh: : 哦。早上好，Yumi。你需要帮忙做数学作业吗——

lines.en: scene stillcalm21
: Sure! Could you give me just one second, though? There’s something I’ve gotta take care of first.
lines.zh: : 当然！不过能给我一秒钟吗？我得先处理一件事。

lines.en: : What?...
: Why are you-
lines.zh: : 你为什么——

lines.en: : It’s been nice knowing you, Futaba. Please remember me as the girl who taught you how to properly handle rational expressions.
lines.zh: : 认识你真好，Futaba。请记住我，就当我是那个教会你正确处理有理式的女孩。

lines.en: scene stillcalm22
: You think this is a fucking joke?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得这他妈的是个玩笑？！

lines.en: : You think you can just walk all over people like that?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能就这么骑在别人头上？！

lines.en: : Yumi, stop! Leave her alone!
lines.zh: : Yumi，住手！别碰她！

lines.en: : You happy you took shit into your own hands?! Was it worth it?! Was it fucking worth it?!
lines.zh: : 你亲手揽下这摊事，开心了吗？！值不值得？！这他妈的值不值得？！

lines.en: : What’s...wait, is that Nodoka down there?! What the fuck happened?!
lines.zh: : 什么……等等，下面那个是 Nodoka 吗？！到底他妈的发生什么了？！

lines.en: : Senpai! We’ve got a bit of a situation over here!
lines.zh: : 前辈！这边出状况了！

lines.en: : You think I’m a fucking joke?! That I deserve shit like that because of what I’ve done in the past?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是个他妈的笑话？！觉得因为我过去做过的事，我就活该被这么对待？！

lines.en: : You think I don’t fucking regret it?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得我没有他妈的后悔过吗？！

lines.en: : Fuck you! Fuck you, fuck you, fuck you!
lines.zh: : 去你的！去你的，去你的，去你的！

lines.en: : Kendo Princess! Attack formation! The only one who can defeat the demon lord is you!
lines.zh: : 剑道公主！攻击阵型！能打败魔王的只有你！

lines.en: : Yumi?!?! What the fuck are you doing?! Get off of her!
lines.zh: : Yumi？！？！你他妈的在干什么？！从她身上下来！

lines.en: : Eat shit and fucking die! No one embarrasses me like that! No one!
lines.zh: : 吃屎去死吧！没有人能那样羞辱我！没有人！

lines.en: scene stillcalm23
: Oh my God...Oh my God...
lines.zh: : 我的天哪……我的天哪……

lines.en: : What happened?! I didn’t even realize Yumi walked in!
lines.zh: : 发生什么了？！我都没注意到 Yumi 进来了！

lines.en: : This...
: This isn't because Nodoka stood up for Futaba in class a while back, is it?...
lines.zh: : 该不会是因为之前 Nodoka 在课上替 Futaba 出头那件事吧？……

lines.en: : Is that seriously all it takes to set this girl off?
lines.zh: : 真的就这点事就能让她炸成这样？

lines.en: : Senpai! Why are you just standing there?! What are you doing?!
lines.zh: : 前辈！你为什么就站在那儿？！你在干什么？！

lines.en: scene stillcalm24
: I told you I’d fucking kill you, didn’t I?! I fucking...told you!
lines.zh: : 我说过我会杀了你，对不对？！我他妈的……说过！

lines.en: : Jesus, Yumi! Give the damn girl a break! Ain’t she had enough?!
lines.zh: : 天哪，Yumi！放过那姑娘吧！她受的还不够多吗？！

lines.en: : No! There’s never...too much for...people like her!
lines.zh: : 不！对……她这种人来说……永远都不够多！

lines.en: : People who...get a rise out of...hurting others!
lines.zh: : 那些……以伤害别人为乐的人！

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. That’s rich. Yumi calling people out for hurting others.
lines.zh: : 哦，对啊。真有说服力。Yumi 来指责别人伤害他人。

lines.en: : What the fuck has Nodoka ever done to anyone?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 到底对谁做过什么伤天害理的事？

lines.en: : Yumi! Stop it! Please!
lines.zh: : Yumi！住手！求你了！

lines.en: : Is she unconscious? It doesn’t even look like she’s moving anymore.
lines.zh: : 她是不是昏过去了？看起来她已经完全不动了。

lines.en: : Hang in there, Nodoka! We’re all rootin’ for ya! Even if...ya might be dead already!
lines.zh: : 撑住啊，Nodoka！我们都在给你加油！虽然……你可能已经死了！

lines.en: : I fucking hope she is! She deserves it! She fucking deserves it! She fucking deserves-
lines.zh: : 我真他妈的希望她死了！她活该！她他妈的活该！她他妈的活——

lines.en: scene stillcalm25
: Okay! That’s enough of that! You’re done!
lines.zh: : 好了！够了！你完了！

lines.en: : Bullying will not be tolerated. You are lucky you are leaving here with your life.
lines.zh: : 霸凌绝不被容忍。你能活着离开这里，已经算走运了。

lines.en: : Let me go! Let me go! I ain’t fuckin’ done yet!
lines.zh: : 放开我！放开我！我他妈的还没完！

lines.en: : I’m so disappointed in you, Yumi...it really seemed like you were getting better...
lines.zh: : 我对你太失望了，Yumi……真的看起来你已经好起来了……

lines.en: : Fight me back, you cunt! Fight me the fuck back! Now’s your fucking chance!
lines.zh: : 还手啊，你这婊子！他妈的还手啊！现在就是你的机会！

lines.en: : Now {i}would{/i} be her chance if you didn’t knock her the fuck out already. That was barely even a fight.
lines.zh: : 如果你没把她打昏，她现在倒是{i}能{/i}还手。这根本算不上打架。

lines.en: : Yeah...Yumi just straight up tried to kill Nodoka when all she was doin’ was helpin’ Futaba study. I saw the whole thing.
lines.zh: : 是啊……Yumi 就是在 Nodoka 帮 Futaba 复习的时候，直接想弄死她。我全看见了。

lines.en: : If only Ayane was here today. She could have taken Yumi. Right, Maya?
lines.zh: : 要是 Ayane 今天在就好了。她能收拾 Yumi。对吧，Maya？

lines.en: : Please don’t get me involved in this. I would very much like to avoid saying anything that may paint a target on {i}my{/i} back as well.
lines.zh: : 请别把我卷进去。我非常想避免说出任何可能让{i}我自己{/i}也被盯上的话。

lines.en: : Get the fuck up, you bitch! We’re not done! We’re not even close to done, you hear me?!
lines.zh: : 他妈的给我起来，你这贱人！我们还没完！离完还早着呢，听见没有？！

lines.en: : I’ll fucking kill you!
lines.zh: : 我会杀了你！

lines.en: : {b}I will fucking kill you!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}我一定会杀了你！{/b}

lines.en: scene black
Imani and Tsuneyo manage to pull Yumi back to her feet and lock her arms behind her back so she can’t wreak any further havoc.
lines.zh: Imani 和 Tsuneyo 总算把 Yumi 拽了起来，把她的双臂锁在身后，让她没法继续闹下去。

lines.en: As for why I remained inactive...
lines.zh: 至于我为什么一直没动……

lines.en: Well, you probably already know.
lines.zh: 嗯，你大概已经知道了。

lines.en: I {i}understand{/i} what Nodoka did.
lines.zh: 我{i}明白{/i} Nodoka 做了什么。

lines.en: I was {i}there{/i} for it.
lines.zh: 我当时{i}在场{/i}。

lines.en: But it’s not like I can come out and say anything about it because that would make me complicit.
lines.zh: 可我也不能站出来说什么，因为那会让我成为共犯。

lines.en: The fact that I was there and didn’t do anything to stop it makes me almost as bad as her.
lines.zh: 我在场却什么都没做来阻止，这让我差不多跟她一样坏。

lines.en: It’s just a shame that it won’t look that way to anyone but the three of us...
lines.zh: 只可惜，除了我们三个，在任何人眼里都不会是那样……

lines.en: And that Yumi’s delinquent persona, which she’d been slowly chipping away at over time, is suddenly covered with a {i}new{/i} layer of stone, even harder than the one before it.
lines.zh: 而 Yumi 那层不良少女的外壳——她本已一点一点慢慢凿掉——突然又被覆上了一层{i}新{/i}的石头，比之前那层更硬。

lines.en: I remain unmoving, experiencing the secondhand fallout of lecherous misdeeds, still in disbelief that something like this will ever happen to me.
lines.zh: 我一动不动地站着，承受着好色劣行的二手余波，仍不敢相信这样的事会发生在我身上。

lines.en: Not because I don’t deserve it, though.
lines.zh: 不过不是因为我不配。

lines.en: But because I’m far too powerful to be brought down by a single teenage girl-
lines.zh: 而是因为我还太强大，不会被一个女高中生打倒——

lines.en: And much more used to bringing them to their knees instead.
lines.zh: 我更习惯的，是让她们跪下来。

lines.en: scene stillcalm26
: You really weren’t kidding when you said you were leaving the class to {i}me{/i} today, huh?
lines.zh: : 你说今天把班交给{i}我{/i}，还真是没开玩笑啊？

lines.en: : We’re lucky Tsuneyo was around. Because with you deciding to turn into a statue at the worst possible time, I would have been left to fend for myself without her. And this girl is fucking strong, dude.
lines.zh: : 幸好 Tsuneyo 在。因为你在最糟糕的时机变成了雕像，要是没有她，我就得一个人扛了。而且这姑娘他妈的力气真大，老兄。

lines.en: : Why didn’t you help? You could have pulled her off by yourself.
lines.zh: : 你为什么不来帮忙？你一个人就能把她拉开。

lines.en: : Does it fucking matter? You got me off of her. Now just take me down to the principal’s office so I can get expelled or whatever.
lines.zh: : 这他妈的重要吗？你们把我拉开了。现在就带我去校长室，让我被开除什么的吧。

lines.en: : I’m done with this shit anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我受够这些破事了。

lines.en: scene stillcalm27
: Hah...yeah. I guess now probably isn’t the best time to talk about this.
lines.zh: : 哈……是啊。看来现在大概不是谈这个的好时机。

lines.en: : I don’t know if you’re going to get {i}expelled{/i} for this, Yumi...But, at the very least, I doubt you’ll be coming here for a while.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你会不会因此被{i}开除{/i}，Yumi……但至少，我觉得你短期内是回不来了。

lines.en: : Best news I’ve heard all fuckin’ year.
lines.zh: : 这他妈的是我今年听过最好的消息。

lines.en: : How many more people will be hurt under your supervision?
lines.zh: : 在你的看管之下，还要有多少人受伤？

lines.en: : You should be ashamed of yourself.
lines.zh: : 你应该为自己感到羞耻。

lines.en: : That’s-
scene stillcalm28
: Yumi! What the fuck was that?!
lines.zh: : Yumi！你他妈的这是干什么？！

lines.en: : You were doing so well! You apologized to Futaba! You joined a club on your own! I was so proud of you!
lines.zh: : 你一直做得那么好！你向 Futaba 道了歉！你自己加入了社团！我为你骄傲极了！

lines.en: : But...this?!
lines.zh: : 可……这是怎么回事？！

lines.en: : How can I be proud of {i}this?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}让我怎么骄傲得起来？！

lines.en: : What if something like this happens around Chinami?! What if you decide to snap when I’m not around?! Then what?!
lines.zh: : 万一这种事发生在 Chinami 身边呢？！万一我不在的时候你突然发作呢？！那怎么办？！

lines.en: scene stillcalm29
: Please...
lines.zh: : 求你了……

lines.en: : Just take me to the fucking office already...
lines.zh: : 直接带我去校长室就行了……

lines.en: : Yumi...
lines.zh: : Yumi……

lines.en: : You heard her, Tsuneyo. Let’s get our little prisoner to the principal’s office and hope Sensei has a damn good excuse when we make it back to the classroom.
lines.zh: : 你听到了，Tsuneyo。把我们的小囚犯送去校长室吧，然后祈祷我们回到教室时，老师有个像样的借口。

lines.en: scene black
scene stillcalm30
: Nodoka...you doing okay? I’ve got a whole stash of painkillers in my bag and you look like you could use...a few hundred of them.
lines.zh: : Nodoka……你还好吗？我包里有一大堆止痛药，而你看上去需要……几百片。

lines.en: : Get up slowly. And if ya feel like yer fallin’ asleep, do your best to...not do that. Wouldn’t be surprised if ya had a concussion at this rate.
lines.zh: : 慢慢起来。要是你觉得快睡着了，尽量……别睡着。照这个样子，你要是脑震荡了我都不意外。

lines.en: : Straight up, I seriously thought you were going to die. So kudos to you for actually living through that.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我真以为你要死了。所以你居然活下来了，值得敬佩。

lines.en: : Heh...
: Heheheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Is she seriously laughing right now?
lines.zh: : 她现在真的在笑吗？

lines.en: : Could be brain damage. Wouldn’t be surprised with how many times she got clocked on the head.
lines.zh: : 可能是脑损伤。看她头上挨了多少下，我一点都不意外。

lines.en: : I don’t have any pills for that, but ibuprofen works for pretty much anything, so who even knows?
lines.zh: : 那个我没有药，不过布洛芬对什么都管用，所以谁知道呢？

lines.en: scene stillcalm31
: Sensei, Rin and I are gonna take Nodoka to the nurse’s office.
lines.zh: : 老师，我和 Rin 要带 Nodoka 去医务室。

lines.en: : And, uhh...if you see Futaba...maybe try cheering her up a little?
lines.zh: : 还有，呃……如果你见到 Futaba……也许试着让她开心一点？

lines.en: : She ran out of the room really shaken up once Nodoka started waking up and...probably went back to the dorm. But, just in case she didn’t...you know what to do.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 一有醒过来的迹象，她就慌慌张张跑出去了……大概是回了宿舍。不过万一她没回去……你知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : Sure, yeah.
lines.zh: : 好，行。

lines.en: : And, uhh...how are you holding up, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 还有，呃……你撑得住吗，Nodoka？

lines.en: : Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Heheheheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: : It was worth every last punch...
lines.zh: : 每一拳都值了……

lines.en: : If getting hit like that...allows me to be the meat of a lesbian sandwich...I should get into fights more often...
lines.zh: : 如果被打成那样……能让我当上女同三明治里的那块肉……我应该多打几次架……

lines.en: scene stillcalm32
: Okay. Tell it to the nurse, Rocky.
lines.zh: : 好了。这话留着跟护士说吧，洛奇。

lines.en: : The nurse is actually out on Fridays, Otoha. You and I are going to have to take care of Nodoka ourselves.
lines.zh: : 护士周五其实不在，Otoha。我和你得自己照顾 Nodoka 了。

lines.en: : Wow...today keeps getting better and better...
lines.zh: : 哇……今天真是越来越棒了……

lines.en: scene black
Otoha and Rin walk Nodoka out of the classroom, leaving all of their possessions (Including one very bent pair of glasses) behind.
lines.zh: Otoha 和 Rin 扶着 Nodoka 走出教室，把她们所有的东西（包括一副严重扭曲的眼镜）都留在了原地。

lines.en: The class erupts into a fit of chatter once the door slides closed again as they all begin to discuss what could have caused this.
lines.zh: 门重新关上之后，全班炸开了锅，纷纷讨论起这件事的起因。

lines.en: The general consensus is, unsurprisingly, that Yumi is just unhinged.
lines.zh: 不出所料，大家的共识是：Yumi 就是疯了。

lines.en: And that this was bound to happen sooner or later.
lines.zh: 这种事早晚会发生。

lines.en: And that they’d be shocked if she’s ever allowed back in school.
lines.zh: 如果她还能被允许回学校，他们会很震惊。

lines.en: About how no one ever really liked her anyway.
lines.zh: 还有：反正从来没有人真的喜欢过她。

lines.en: And about how she’s a terrible person with a fetish for tearing others down...
lines.zh: 还有：她是个糟糕的人，以把别人踩下去为癖好……

lines.en: And does what she wants whenever she wants to do it...
lines.zh: 想做什么就做什么，想什么时候做就什么时候做……

lines.en: And thinks so highly of herself that she won’t even bother showing up to school...
lines.zh: 自视甚高，连学都懒得来上……

lines.en: But it’s all wrong.
lines.zh: 但这一切都是错的。

lines.en: They don’t understand her like I have begun to.
lines.zh: 他们不像我开始那样理解她。

lines.en: And the only person beside me who can actually tell them about her is too busy blocking the incessant chatter out with her hands pressed to her ears and tears streaming down her cheeks.
lines.zh: 而除我之外唯一能真正告诉他们她是什么样的人，此刻正忙着用双手捂住耳朵，把没完没了的闲言碎语挡在外面，泪水顺着脸颊流下来。

lines.en: Out of my peripheral vision, I manage to find the only other silent observer in the room right now.
lines.zh: 从余光里，我找到了此刻教室里唯一另一个沉默的旁观者。

lines.en: And it is at that moment when I realize just how accurate her premonition was.
lines.zh: 就在那一刻，我意识到她的预感有多么准确。

lines.en: scene stillcalm33
: Well...
: Looks like the “whispers of the world” weren’t lying.
lines.zh: : 看来「世界的低语」没有撒谎。

lines.en: : Something bad happened after all.
lines.zh: : 到底还是有坏事发生了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for doubting you. I just didn’t-
lines.zh: : 抱歉我怀疑了你。我只是没有——

lines.en: : That wasn’t it.
lines.zh: : 不是那件事。

lines.en: scene stillcalm34
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : That wasn’t it.
lines.zh: : 不是那件事。
